origin.source: Eve (Vercel's agent framework) folder convention — agent.ts + tools/<snake_case>.ts calling runAgent; typechecks standalone via local eve-shims mirroring eve.dev/docs as of 2026-07 (Eve is not a repo dependency)

comparison.purpose: The Eve LLM agent gets two tools bridging to a statelyai/agent machine: start_workflow runs runAgent to idle/done and returns a JSON-safe handle + typed interaction; resume_workflow revives the handle with the human's event. The machine owns legality; the agent converses.
